end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi gave 1 unaided correct response across 3 attempts.
They identified 12 as ten and two, and 17 as one ten and seven ones.
The meaning of the 1 in 14/15 remained mixed up; it was not corrected later.
Lesson ended when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making numbers 11–20 with one bundle of ten and loose ones. Saanvi used the method correctly for 12 and 17. The mix-up about the 1 showing one ten, rather than one, remained at the end. At home, build 14 or 15 with one group of ten straws and 4 or 5 single straws, then say the number aloud.
